title: GroceryDB Expository Visualization
description: A single static visualization for DSC 106 Project 1 made from GroceryDB, which has food products from Walmart, Target and Whole Foods. I cleaned the data in Python and wrote up every assumption I made about outliers and missing values.

title: Recipe Complexity and Ratings
description: A DSC 80 project using the Food.com dataset of about 83,000 recipes and 731,000 reviews. It looks at whether recipes with more steps and ingredients get lower or higher ratings.

title: k-NN Digit Classifier
description: Homework for DSC 140A where I wrote a k-nearest neighbors classifier in NumPy and tested it on the MNIST handwritten digits dataset.

title: Wholesaler Jewelry Store
description: A direct-to-consumer jewelry storefront with a custom Next.js and TypeScript frontend on a headless Shopify backend. Shopify handles the catalog and checkout, and it accepts both card and crypto.

title: AdLevel
description: An AI tool that creates and launches Meta lead generation ad campaigns for small businesses, then tracks the results and adjusts the campaigns over time.

title: DocPassenger
description: A web platform for US daycare providers where parents fill out and e-sign enrollment PDF forms. When a new version of a government form comes out, it fills the new form from each child's existing data so parents do not have to type it again.

title: UCSD Course Catalog API
description: A read-only REST API that serves UCSD course catalog data like departments, courses and sections, so students can build course planners without scraping.

title: Bitcoin Forecasting with LSTM
description: An entry-level model that collects Bitcoin candle data into pandas and trains an LSTM with TensorFlow to predict where the market moves next.

title: Discord Collage Maker
description: A Python script that pulls images from a Discord channel with Discord.py and turns them into one collage with a single command.

title: Trading News Discord Bot
description: A Python Discord bot that turns trading news links into clean embed posts in a news channel with a .newspost command.

title: Walmart Restock Monitor
description: Watches the Walmart website for an item and sends a Discord alert when it comes back in stock. I made it during COVID-19 to help people find essentials like medicine and masks.

title: Twitter Monitor
description: A Node.js bot that watches chosen Twitter accounts, reads text inside tweet images with OCR and sends new posts to Discord.
